sources.title: Playboy Interview: Steven Jobs
sources.quote_checked: You'll know it's there, so you're going to use a beautiful piece of wood on the back.

sources.title: Interview with Steve Jobs
sources.quote_checked: It's really hard to design products by focus groups. A lot of times, people don't know what they want until you show it to them.

sources.title: Stanford Commencement Address
sources.quote_checked: Don't be trapped by dogma, which is living with the results of other people's thinking.

sources.title: The Guts of a New Machine
sources.quote_checked: It's not just what it looks like and feels like. Design is how it works.

sources.title: Real Artists Ship
sources.quote_checked: Just make it as good as you can. You better get back to work!
